error[ZBX-E0604]: a published host port is already in use
  while  starting container web-1
  while  publishing the container's ports
  cause  pasta: Failed to bind port 8080 (Address already in use) for option '-t
         8080:80', exiting
  cause  another program already listens on host port 8080
  port   8080
  log    /home/alice/.local/state/zbx/logs/web-1.pasta.log
  name   web-1
  rootfs /srv/alpine
  step   await_pasta (6 of 65)
  fix    see which program holds it:     ss -tlnp 'sport = :8080'
         or publish another host port:   zbx run --publish 8081:80 nginx
  more   zbx explain E0604
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0604.html
